camel_example: aliyun ims ListUserBasicInfos --region cn-hangzhou --Status active --Tag.1.Key operator --Tag.1.Value alice --Marker EXAMPLE --MaxItems 100
description_en: Queries the basic information about all Resource Access Management (RAM) users
description_zh: 调用ListUserBasicInfos查询所有RAM用户的基本信息
kebab_example: aliyun ims list-user-basic-infos --marker EXAMPLE --max-items 100 --tag Value=alice Key=operator --status active --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUserBasicInfos

parameters.help_en: The `marker`. If part of a previous response is truncated, you can use this parameter to obtain the truncated part
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，可以使用`Marker`获取从当前截断位置之后的内容。
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return. If a response is truncated because it reaches the value of `MaxItems`, the value of `IsTruncated` will be `true`.

Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果的条数。当返回结果达到`MaxItems`限制被截断时，返回参数`IsTruncated`将等于`true`。 

取值范围：1~1000。默认值：100
parameters.name: max_items

element_fields.help_en:
The key of tag N.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20. N must be consecutive
element_fields.help_zh:
标签键。

N的取值范围：1~20，N必须连续
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The value of tag N.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20. N must be consecutive
element_fields.help_zh:
标签值。

N的取值范围：1~20，N必须连续
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The status of the RAM users that you want to query. Valid values: active, freeze, and active,freeze. If you set the value to active,freeze, RAM users in both active and freeze states are queried. If you leave the parameter empty, the value active is used by default. If the Tag parameter is specified, you cannot specify the Status parameter. In this case, RAM users in both states are queried
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询的用户状态，支持active，freeze状态。指定全部状态时使用逗号拼接，如：active,freeze。未指定状态时默认指定active状态。
使用Tag标签时，不支持指定status查询，默认查询全部状态的用户
parameters.name: status
